name: creative-search
description: Search for WooCommerce: live suggestions, typo tolerance, an index of its own, analytics, an accessible search bar.
author: Zach Atkinson

scripts.plugin-check: wp-env run cli wp plugin check creative-search --exclude-directories=tests,tools,node_modules,vendor,tmp,docs,test-results,playwright-report,.claude,.github --exclude-files=.wp-env.json,.wp-env.override.json,.gitignore,.distignore,.editorconfig,.nvmrc,CLAUDE.md,composer.json,composer.lock,package.json,package-lock.json,phpcs.xml,phpstan.neon,phpunit.xml.dist,phpunit-integration.xml.dist,infection.json5,infection-domain.json5,playwright.config.ts,eslint.config.js,.stylelintrc.json,.prettierrc.js
scripts.check: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run format:check
